verdict.rationale: Factory documents an official MCP server endpoint (docs.factory.ai/harness/mcp) per probe evidence, which satisfies the exception where an agent product actually ships a server mode rather than just consuming MCP tools. However, the evidence pack only confirms the page exists via a probe and lacks first-party documentation detailing connection setup, authentication, or tool exposure for external agents. missing for 10: detailed docs on how another agent connects to Factory's MCP server, independent/hands-on confirmation it works, and specifics on exposed tools/capabilities.
